title: Make imported plan names editable
purpose: Allow the user-facing name of an imported plan or collection to be chosen during import and renamed later from the Library without changing technical package identity or losing learner state.

baseline.candidateName: RC718 editable imported plan naming candidate

invariants: importPackageId remains the immutable technical identity of the imported plan
localCourseId remains unchanged when a plan is renamed
progress, bilan and resume state survive plan renaming and durable restoration
only imported plans can be renamed
empty, overlong and explicit duplicate plan names are rejected
default duplicate source titles are disambiguated without blocking unrelated course collision policies
requiredEvidence: large import and collision regression tests
library and product flow regression tests
adversarialTests: rename an imported plan and restore it from durable storage
verify course identifiers and learner progress do not change
reject a duplicate name explicitly entered by the user
auto-disambiguate a duplicate source-derived plan title
exercise rename, replace, skip and reject course-collision policies after a large import
independentReview: focused human validation after the automated candidate
rollback: Revert the RC718 pull request. Existing imported course identities and RC715 durable snapshots remain compatible because the new collection title is an additive presentation field.
